description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for session and tenant management, including listing tenants, setting active tenants, and toggling global tenant scope. It includes middleware integrations, access control, and audit logging.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Returns a list of tenants associated with the current authenticated user, with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the current session, validates RBAC, updates cookies, and logs the action.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route that redirects to set active tenant, with similar logic.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Allows a super admin to toggle a global tenant scope for the session/request, with audit logging.
